bundle.shortDescription: Rook Node — the forever-free computer runner for your Bots.
bundle.longDescription: Rook Node runs a supervised, version-pinned Chromium on the user's own computer. It provides a dedicated Rook profile, per-Bot tab groups, a control gateway, durable local state, a shared workspace, and live-screen input control. The app remains the control surface; the user's own machine becomes the Bot computer.
